title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Impact on Model Complexity
